timing.qualification: Durations are recorded execution; interval union prevents overlap. Residual includes coordination, waits and uninstrumented work; it is not all idle time. Coordination spans and document closeout are separate, never added twice.

verification.qualification: Sealed check declarations and pinned validator bytes only; no tests rerun or independent verification of the declared requirement policy.
